notes.text: Johannes Erwin Eugen Erwin Rommel, known as The Desert Fox, was a German Generalfeldmarschall during World War II.
Erwin Rommel served in the Wehrmacht of Nazi Germany, as well as in the Reichswehr of the Weimar Republic, and Imperial German Army of the German Empire.
Erwin Rommel is remembered as a military personnel connected with Germany.
Erwin Rommel's recorded life dates place this profile around 1891-1944.
Erwin Rommel is grouped with Justice, Governance & Leadership in the People Library.
